---
title: "Rolling windows and as-of joins"
---

Give each day of sales the price in force on that date and the mean of its units over the last three calendar days, on dates with gaps.

Requires the phpolars extension ([Getting started](../getting-started.qmd)). Script: [time-series.php](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phpstats/phpolars/main/docs/examples/time-series.php).

{{< include _time-series.md >}}

- `joinAsof()` matches backward by default. Each row of `$sales` gets the last row of `$prices` whose `from` is on or before its `date`. Both inputs must be sorted by their join columns, and unsorted input raises an `InvalidOperationError`. The [reference](../reference/dataframe.qmd#dataframe-joinAsof) covers `strategy: 'forward'` and `'nearest'`, `tolerance`, and `by` groups.
- `rollingMeanBy('date', '3d')` uses the window `(date - 3d, date]`, so it excludes the date three days earlier and includes the row's own date. This is the default `closed: 'right'`. `closed` also accepts `'left'`, `'both'`, and `'none'`.
- The window keeps its three-day duration when dates are missing, and it holds fewer rows. The window for March 4 holds March 2 and March 4, because March 3 has no row and March 1 is the excluded endpoint.
- `rollingMean(3)` would average the last three rows instead, whatever their dates.

Reference: [joinAsof()](../reference/dataframe.qmd#dataframe-joinAsof) · [rollingMeanBy()](../reference/expressions.qmd#expr-rollingMeanBy) · [Time series](../reference/dataframe.qmd#time-series) · [Dates and times](../reference/expressions.qmd#dates-and-times)
